newsitem.title: USA: General Parcel replaces board, has new plan.
newsitem.headline: General Parcel replaces board, has new plan.

text.p: General Parcel Service Inc said Wednesday it has replaced all board members other than Chairman T. Wayne Davis with three new directors.
The company said the move is part of a new business plan aimed at restoring profitability to current operations and expanding growth horizons.

The new members are Sonny Ellis, a private investor in Atlanta; Derek Dewan, the chairman, president and chief executive of AccuStaff Inc; and General Parcel's president and chief executive, Philip Belyew.

The company said it also will form a holding company in Atlanta, Georgia, with shareholder approval. GPS said the holding company would increase its ability to pursue the acquisition of less-than-load and truckload motor carriers and leverage its parcel business by expanding into trucking.
Targets would be mid-sized trucking companies with annual revenues between $10 and $100 million, the company said.
